channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Jay Clayton Appointed Interim National Cyber Director
item.description: Jay Clayton, identified as an intelligence leader and former Trump appointee, has been appointed to serve as the interim national cyber director. This appointment places him in a key role overseeing national cybersecurity efforts. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump Criticizes Schumer Amid US Senate Leadership Speculation
item.description: Former US President Donald Trump has criticized Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, suggesting difficulties if Schumer continues in a leadership role. The coverage does not specify the exact nature of Trump's criticism or the context of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: FIFA President's 96-Year World Cup Sale Plan Revealed
item.description: Leaked documents reportedly reveal a 96-year plan proposed by FIFA President Gianni Infantino for the sale of World Cup rights. The plan was detailed in documents obtained by The New York Times and reported by the Irish Independent. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: New York Lawmaker Proposes Bill to Regulate Prediction Markets
item.description: A New York lawmaker has proposed a bill to regulate and tax prediction markets. These markets are described not as games of chance, but as investments based on specific knowledge of potential outcomes. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US military memo restricts soldier interaction with Canadians
item.description: A memo reportedly circulated by US official David Hegseth last week restricts American soldiers from socializing with their Canadian counterparts without permission. One Canadian official described the memo as 'a slap in the face.' Despite… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Netanyahu, Eisenkot Parties Fail to Form Israeli Government
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party and Benny Gantz's National Unity party have concluded talks without reaching an agreement to form a new government in Israel. Gadi Eisenkot, representing Gantz's party, met with Netanyahu to discuss the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UK, US Democrat Criticize SpaceX Ukraine Restrictions
item.description: Britain stated that restrictions imposed by SpaceX in Ukraine have "dented confidence and trust." Separately, a US Democrat has threatened to block funding for SpaceX, citing concerns over the slowdown of Ukraine's Starshield program. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Government Employee Salary Hike Under 8th Pay Commission Proposed
item.description: Proposals for revising central government employee salaries under the 8th Pay Commission are being considered, with potential changes to basic pay based on proposed fitment factors. Employee unions have suggested multipliers of 3.61… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump makes claims about US control and Somali community
item.description: Donald Trump claimed the United States has "total control" over the Strait of Hormuz. In a separate statement, he also claimed that the Somali community has "completely taken over" Minnesota. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Parliament's Monsoon Session Remains Open After 100 Days
item.description: Parliament's Monsoon Session has remained open for a record 101 days, exceeding 100 days since its adjournment sine die. This extended duration is the longest in the history of Parliament. Speculation exists regarding a delimitation bill… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Iran Vows to Counter US Naval Blockade with 'All Available Means'
item.description: Iran has stated it will employ 'all available means' and 'all tools' to confront the United States' naval blockade and defend itself. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs indicated that measures are being taken to break the blockade, with one… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: West Bengal to be renamed Paschim Banga, cabinet approves
item.description: The West Bengal cabinet has approved a proposal to rename the state "Paschim Banga". The proposal is expected to be presented in the state assembly soon. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari made the announcement. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: Tajikistan Announces Withdrawal from International Criminal Court
item.description: Tajikistan has announced its decision to withdraw from the International Criminal Court (ICC). This move makes Tajikistan the fourth country to leave the ICC since the United States began a diplomatic push against the court. The… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Quebec court rules legislators must swear oath to King
item.description: A Quebec court has ruled that provincial legislators must swear an oath to King Charles III. The court suspended a law that had made it optional for them to do so. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Indonesian President Names Vice President Candidates to Parliament
item.description: Indonesian President Joko Widodo has submitted the names of two vice presidential candidates to parliament. The candidates are intended to replace Gibran Rakabuming Raka, who is currently running for president. The specific names of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Akhilesh Yadav's Facebook Account Briefly Suspended
item.description: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav's Facebook account was temporarily suspended, making his page with over 9 million followers unavailable for approximately 90 minutes. The suspension caused concern among his supporters. The reason for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Belgium Faces Transport Chaos Amid Anti-Austerity Strike
item.description: A national strike against planned austerity measures has caused widespread transport disruption across Belgium. The government's future is reportedly in question following the strike. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Spain's snap election seen as gamble on far-right's rise
item.description: Spain's snap election is being characterized as a significant political gamble by Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, with concerns raised about potentially opening the door for the far-right. The election is viewed by some as a referendum on… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: French President Macron Faces Protests Over Fiscal Policies
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron is facing protests and criticism regarding his fiscal policies, with some characterizing his actions as an attempt to impose fiscal discipline on a future successor. Reports indicate that the far-left is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Republicans Debate Party's Future After Midterm Losses
item.description: Following midterm election losses, Republicans are engaged in internal discussions about the future direction of the party. These debates come after the Republican party's performance in the midterms, with the coverage indicating a period… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Kim Jong Un reportedly ignored Trump's calls and returned letters unopened
item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un reportedly ignored calls from former U.S. President Donald Trump and returned letters from him unopened. The reports indicate a breakdown in communication between the two leaders. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Ex-Mossad Chief Warns of Iran War, Netanyahu Pushes for Strikes
item.description: Former Mossad chief David Barnea has stated that Israel must prepare for another war with Iran, suggesting that a deal with Tehran would not be sustainable. Caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is reportedly seeking US backing for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: India-US Defence Partnership Gains Momentum Through Military Exercises
item.description: The India-U.S. defence relationship has been described as a "Major Defence Partnership" by the U.S. Embassy, with momentum generated by an increasing number of military exercises. Four major exercises across land, air, and maritime domains… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: S. Jaishankar Discusses Issues with Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov
item.description: India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar spoke with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov over the phone. The specific issues discussed were not detailed in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Election Commission Faces Questions Over Maharashtra Voting Data
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) has faced questions regarding voting data from Maharashtra, with the opposition highlighting discrepancies. Specifically, the opposition pointed to a difference in voter numbers shown in data from… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bengal Announces Monthly Allowance for Unemployed Graduates
item.description: The government of West Bengal has announced a monthly allowance of Rs 2,000 for unemployed graduates, set to begin in January. This initiative aims to support unemployed graduates in the state. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: MP Cabinet Approves ₹7,000 Crore for Infrastructure and Welfare
item.description: The Madhya Pradesh cabinet has approved an allocation of ₹7,000 crore for infrastructure development and welfare schemes. The funds are designated for projects aimed at improving infrastructure and supporting various welfare initiatives… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Maharashtra CEO Denies Poll Irregularities Report
item.description: Maharashtra's Chief Electoral Officer has dismissed reports alleging irregularities during the 2024 polls, calling the claims "misleading", "false", and "baseless". The reports specifically questioned whether there was a record of votes… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Reinstated Amid Political Pressure and AI Concerns
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been reinstated following a period of political engagement and speculation. His return has drawn reactions from various figures, including Elon Musk and former President Donald Trump, who reportedly directed… Coverage: Left 7 · Centre 30 · Right 5.

item.title: Bihar CM Vacates Seat for Opposition Leader in Assembly
item.description: During the oath-taking ceremony of newly elected members in the Bihar Legislative Council, Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary had Minister Ramkripal Yadav vacate his seat for opposition leader Tejashwi Yadav. Tejashwi Yadav was then called to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Azam Khan criticizes Owaisi and Azad's Muslim-Dalit alliance
item.description: Azam Khan, a prominent Muslim leader of the Samajwadi Party, has engaged in a verbal exchange with Asaduddin Owaisi, particularly over Owaisi's "Abdul will lay the carpet" slogan. Khan has also criticized the alliance formed by Owaisi with… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump Signals Openness to Healthcare Plan Pitched by Abdul El-Sayed
item.description: Former US President Donald Trump has signaled openness to working with Abdul El-Sayed on healthcare, reposting mock-up images of a 'Trumpcare' gold card that El-Sayed had shared. El-Sayed, who is advocating for a universal healthcare plan… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Democrat Hubbard Wins North Carolina House Race After Recount
item.description: Democrat Chuck Hubbard has won a U.S. House of Representatives race in North Carolina, defeating 11-term Republican incumbent Virginia Foxx. The victory was confirmed after a recount, which secured a historic House majority for Democrats. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: UK Environmental Regulators Face Potential Abolition Under Labour Review
item.description: Two of England's major environmental regulators, the Environment Agency and Natural England, are under review by the Labour party with the potential for abolition. Labour minister Louise Haigh stated the review is part of a broader… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Toronto City Manager Paul Johnson Departs Amid Leadership Shake-up
item.description: Toronto City Manager Paul Johnson is departing his role as part of a civil service leadership shake-up initiated by Mayor Olivia Chow. Sources indicate Johnson's departure from the city's top bureaucrat position. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: South Korean Education Minister Resigns Amid Backlash
item.description: South Korean Education Minister Lee Ju-ho has resigned following public backlash over proposed anti-artificial intelligence measures in education. The resignation was reported by TIME magazine. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Councils Warn Levy Changes Could Create Suburbs Lacking Basic Amenities
item.description: Local councils are warning that proposed changes to levies could lead to the development of "suburbs without footpaths," implying a lack of essential infrastructure. This concern arises from potential alterations to how development levies… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Cannes Mayor David Lisnard Emerges as French Presidential Contender
item.description: David Lisnard, the mayor of Cannes, has emerged as a surprising contender in French presidential elections, reportedly surpassing former prime ministers Edouard Philippe and Gabriel Attal in a recent voter intention poll. Lisnard is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UK minister tells CBI Europe is not the future market
item.description: UK Business and Trade Secretary Kemi Badenoch told the Confederation of British Industry (CBI) conference in London that Europe is "not the market of the future." She made these remarks during a speech at the conference where other… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Incoming House Speaker Hakeem Jeffries stated his Democratic party's focus on affordability and improving healthcare and immigration systems. He expressed a willingness to collaborate across the political aisle to advance the Democratic… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
